notes.title: Update 0.55.0 - Casual Updates & dynamic Zone Times
notes.content:
[b]Why did we introduce casual lobbies? [/b]
From the ingame data to feedback directly from you: It is clear most new players don't want play with high skilled players in their first match. So we needed a solution for that. There are other options - sure. But with a "small" playerbase (we are still so happy about ~25k daily active player in the last couple days) something like SBMM is not feasible. Casual lobbies were intended as a short time replacement only for new players. 

[b]What happened? [/b]
Casual lobbies - no matter the exact reason - were MUCH more queued than expected. This did what we tried to prevent - splitting the playerbase. That was NOT our intention - we just tried to allow new players to get warm with the game until they go into normal lobbies. 

[b]What are we changing to fix it? [/b]
Ranked is getting disabled for now because its just not played enough right now (a reintroduction with proper ranks and rewards will be come when the playerbase is more stable). We will change how casual lobbies are selected for new players: A new settings will have three modes [Automatic, Casual, Normal]. It will default to automatic and lead to the following behavior: Players from level 1-5 will get into casual games and players above will get into normal queues. You can edit this setting to override whatever you want to play. In the midterm we will add more metadata for our systems in order to get proper indicators for such decisions.  

We will be able to tweak queue settings live based on the queue times and act accordingly.
We are also working on the fixing all the bugs that appeared. Hopefully we will have the update ready tomorrow. We’re not a AAA studio with hundreds of devs. We’re a small team building this game with you, not just for you. We truly appreciate your passion – even when it’s critical – and we’re doing our best to respond fast and transparently. 

In addition we also added dynamic zone times so that if there are some matches with less players the action is more condensed.


[b]Patchnotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled ranked for now
[*] Worked on the bots to make them more reactive
[*] Fixed bug where casual lobbies had no bots
[*] Fixed bug where bot count was off
[*] Fixed bug where casual lobbies would backfill
[*] Added dynamic zone times
[*] Changed the way you queue casual mode with a new setting [Automatic, Casual, Normal]
[*] Anti Cheat Update
[/list]

Fixed bug where bot count was off
Fixed bug where casual lobbies would backfill

Changed the way you queue casual mode with a new setting [Automatic, Casual, Normal]

notes.title: Update 0.54.0 #2
notes.content:
Hey Soldiers!

As you may know we started testing Casual Lobbies today (meaning Lobbies have a mix of Players and Bots)
The main reason that we implemented these was to give new Players a less frustrating and more welcoming experience.
Previously new players were put in the same Lobby as super experienced players which often lead to new players quitting the game before giving it a "proper chance".

The reason we added a Level Cap to the Casual Lobbies was to prevent this case, but as you may experienced that lead to long queue times for Players that didn't have the option to queue into Casual Lobbies.

Some people mentioned that we should rather have SBMM System to reduce the mentioned problem, but even that would leave lots of players with a bad experience.

So, the idea was to have Bots in the Casual Lobbies, so everyone has a chance to experience the Game, make eliminations and learn the game mechanics.
And even though there are bots in the Lobby, players will still face each other off in the final circles in real encounters.

We will definitely have to test out a lot to find a good balance. ⚖️ 

For now, we will remove the Level Cap from Casual Lobbies, so even if new players get queued with really experienced Players, they can still get eliminations, loot and have fun 🔓
Thank you for all the valuable feedback and hopefully we will find a balanced way of Matchmaking in the future! ♥️

notes.title: Early Access is LIVE
notes.content:
Hey Soldiers!

The time has finally come! With a mix of excitement (and just a bit of nervous energy), we’re thrilled to launch [b]Mini Royale into Early Access on Steam[/b]! 🔥

It’s been an incredible journey filled with exciting playtests, and your feedback has been nothing short of amazing. Mini Royale wouldn’t be here without you, so from the bottom of our hearts—thank you! ❤️

[h3]What’s New? Here’s What to Look Forward To![/h3]
[b]Brand-New Season Pass[/b] – Unlock amazing skins, emotes, and more!
[b]The Shop[/b] – Grab even more cool skins and cosmetics!
[b]Exclusive Supporter Pack[/b] as a DLC

🔥 Warm Up Before the Battle!
Get ready to hone your skills on three intense Deathmatch maps:
🏰  Castle Clash
🔴  Flipper Frenzy
🧪  Lab Wars

Please note that we are gonna open [b]ALL [/b]queues at the beginning, so times may be longer on start. 

It’s almost time, and we can’t wait to see you all on the "Bedroom field" for some action-packed fun!

Bear in mind, we are far from done – there is so much [b]more to come[/b]! With a solid foundation in place, we will now, together with all of you, keep pushing forward with full force to bring you new content and features to enjoy.

💥 Get ready to jump in, battle it out, and make your mark!

💛 Your Mini Royale Team

notes.title: Update 0.43.0
notes.content:
[b]Tourney Mode (Alpha)[/b]
We’re thrilled to introduce Tourney Mode - a new system designed to simplify tournament hosting! While it’s still in its early stages, here’s what you can expect:
Easy Tournament Creation: Select from the Mini Royale gamemode with Solo, Duo, or Trio options.
Predefined Teams: Tournament organizers can set up teams in advance. The time where you had to create a party previously is over :)
Player-Friendly Interface: Players will automatically see if they’re in a tournament and can seamlessly join pending games.
Automated Tracking: Team scores, placements, and key stats are automatically tracked for you.
This is just the beginning - we have big plans for more features and customization options to make tournaments even better.

[b]Server Performance[/b]
Over the last months we worked on a new system on how the game servers work. This means the current 30 Soldiers lobbies will run smoother and we have potential for far bigger lobbies now (will be important for future updates :) ). 

[b]Server Deployment[/b]
We’ve also made significant changes to our server setup. As a small team of three developers with no prior experience launching multiplayer games, we initially hosted everything on a single cloud provider. However, we’ve taken a big step forward now:
Enhanced Server Flexibility: Our server now runs on a more versatile system, allowing us to host it everywhere.
Cost Efficiency: This shift means cheaper, more independent servers to reliably support our player base.
Scalability: During surges of new players, we can still leverage the cloud to handle the load.
We are gonna test the new system this weekend - so if you experience any troubles let us know.

[b]Misc[/b]
Fixed Spectating smoothness
Fixed Pick Up Tooltip location off for one frame
Fixed having the wrong viewmode sometimes (fp instead of tp etc)

[b]Anti Cheat[/b]
New Easy Anti Cheat Version

notes.title: New Gamemode, Demo and Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey Soldiers!

as some of you may already know, we will participate in the Steam Next Fest starting on 14th. This means that the new Demo build will be available on our Steam Page [b]now [/b]and the official Servers will be open for [b]at least[/b] 10 Days. 
[i][b]The Playtest build will not be available anymore.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310974/27b7661d9f2a6e2ee382ab04747dcc127f7235aa.png[/img]

The new Gamemode [b]Color Conquest[/b] is a more casual mode. It is enabled [b]now![/b]

We will continue to update the Game prior to Next Fest so everything is smooth when it starts.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[b]New Gamemode[/b]
[list]
[*] Color Conquest: It's a much more casual and free-flowing (Team-Deathmatch like) Gamemode, where 4 Teams with different colors will have to eliminate each other. By killing a player from another team, this player will be transferred to your team and will be redeployed from the corresponding Team Blimp.
[/list]

[b]Breaking Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked how the sensitivity is displayed. We removed the internal multipliers for the different scope stats (reddot, 2x etc). That means the same setting from previous builds lead to different sensitivities!
[/list]

[b]Bots[/b]
[list]
[*] Bots IQ has been improved by 9000. They can shoot, heal, follow the team and much more.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Hipfire inaccuracy between Assault Rifles and Machine Pistols has been reworked. MP’s should be better for close range and AR’s for mid to long range
[*] Fixed bug where you could shoot faster by swapping weapons
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] New Gamemode UI
[*] Also partly reworked Mini Royale ingame UI - this is still WIP
[*] Performance
[*] Improved rendering time for the entire map
[*] Worked on the impact on performance when in heavy fight scenes or similar
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Also added the new gamemode to the custom games creation. We will provide more options for that in the future!
[*] Upgraded Epic Online Service version. This should include several stability fixes.
[*] Fixed ingame Player Ticketing system
[*] Fixed Font for some Languages
[*] Fixed some Localizations
[*] Fixed Proximity Chat, that is very important for the new Gamemode
[*] Fixed issue where Microphone Setting List would not load
[*] Fixed Leaning snapping issue
[*] Fixed Ping attaching to wrong objects
[*] Added progression for the Iron Toy challenge (will be enabled soon)
[*] Added Season Quests (enabled now)
[*] Fixed crash from Abilities
[/list]

[b]Twitch[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed show streamers
[*] Added notify when you claimed a Twitch Drop
[/list]

[b]Anti Cheat[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded to latest Anti Cheat Version
[*] Fixed some edge cases for Cerberus
[/list]

tags.feature: Color Conquest: It's a much more casual and free-flowing (Team-Deathmatch like) Gamemode, where 4 Teams with different colors will have to eliminate each other. By killing a player from another team, this player will be transferred to your team and will be redeployed from the corresponding Team Blimp.

tags.balance_change: Reworked how the sensitivity is displayed. We removed the internal multipliers for the different scope stats (reddot, 2x etc). That means the same setting from previous builds lead to different sensitivities!

tags.feature: Bots IQ has been improved by 9000. They can shoot, heal, follow the team and much more.

tags.balance_change: Hipfire inaccuracy between Assault Rifles and Machine Pistols has been reworked. MP’s should be better for close range and AR’s for mid to long range

tags.bug: Fixed bug where you could shoot faster by swapping weapons

tags.feature: New Gamemode UI
Also partly reworked Mini Royale ingame UI - this is still WIP
Improved rendering time for the entire map
Worked on the impact on performance when in heavy fight scenes or similar
Also added the new gamemode to the custom games creation. We will provide more options for that in the future!
Upgraded Epic Online Service version. This should include several stability fixes.

tags.bug: Fixed ingame Player Ticketing system
Fixed Font for some Languages
Fixed some Localizations
Fixed Proximity Chat, that is very important for the new Gamemode
Fixed issue where Microphone Setting List would not load
Fixed Leaning snapping issue
Fixed Ping attaching to wrong objects

tags.feature: Added progression for the Iron Toy challenge (will be enabled soon)
Added Season Quests (enabled now)

tags.bug: Fixed crash from Abilities
Fixed show streamers

tags.feature: Added notify when you claimed a Twitch Drop
Upgraded to latest Anti Cheat Version

tags.bug: Fixed some edge cases for Cerberus
